title: Эллипсис и замены: so / not, do so, one / ones

why: В русском мы часто опускаем повторяющиеся слова: «Ты придёшь? — Думаю, да». В английском тоже избегают повторов, но делают это по правилам: подставляют so, not, do so, one/ones или просто опускают часть фразы. Так речь звучит естественно и без лишней тяжести.
formation: • so / not после think, hope, suppose, expect, believe, be afraid, guess: I think so. I hope not.
• do so = заменяет глагол с дополнением (формальнее, чем просто do): He asked me to leave, and I did so.
• one / ones заменяют исчисляемое существительное: a red car → a red one; these books → these ones.
• эллипсис: опускаем повторяющуюся часть, оставляя вспомогательный глагол или to: She can swim, and I can too. I didn't want to go, but I had to.
usage: 1. So / not вместо целого придаточного. (Is it going to rain? — I think so. = Будет дождь? — Думаю, да. / I hope not. = Надеюсь, что нет.) Отрицание: с think, believe, suppose, expect чаще I don't think so; с hope и be afraid только I hope not, I'm afraid not.
2. Do so вместо повторения действия. (They told us to submit the form, and we did so immediately. = Нам сказали подать форму, и мы сделали это сразу.)

3. One / ones вместо повтора существительного. (I don't like this laptop. Show me a cheaper one. = Мне не нравится этот ноутбук. Покажите дешевле. / Which shoes? — The black ones. = Какие туфли? — Чёрные.) После слов some, any, both, several, a few, the one stays без one: I'll take some.
4. Эллипсис после вспомогательных. (He hasn't finished, but I have. = Он не закончил, а я закончил. / Can you help? — I'd love to. = Поможешь? — С радостью.)
5. If so / if not. (Do you have time? If so, call me. If not, write. = Есть время? Если да, позвони. Если нет, напиши.)
signalWords: I think / hope / suppose / expect / guess / believe so; I'm afraid so / not; if so, if not; and so do I; so am I; neither do I.
mistakes: ✗ I hope so not. → ✓ I hope not. Not стоит сразу после hope.
✗ I think not so. → ✓ I don't think so. Для think используем отрицание перед глаголом.
✗ Do you like this shirt? I prefer the another one. → ✓ I prefer another one. Перед another не ставим the.
✗ I want a coffee, and she wants a one too. → ✓ and she wants one too. После a/an слово one стоит без артикля, если нет прилагательного.
✗ I think so it will rain. → ✓ I think it will rain / I think so. So и придаточное вместе не используем.
remember: So и not заменяют целое придаточное после think / hope; one / ones заменяют существительное, do so заменяет действие.

exercises.instruction: Вставьте so, not, one или ones

items.prompt: Will the meeting be cancelled? — I hope ___.
Is he coming tonight? — I think ___.
I don't like these shoes. Do you have any other ___?
Is it going to be expensive? — I'm afraid ___.
My phone is old. I need a new ___.
Has the server crashed again? — I hope ___.
Which cups do you want? — The blue ___.
Will they accept our offer? — I don't think ___.
Will it snow tomorrow? — I hope (a) so not (b) not.
He asked me to move my car, and I (a) did so (b) so did at once.
I need a pen. Have you got (a) a one (b) one?
Is she upset? — I (a) don't think so (b) think not so.
Do you want the big boxes or the small (a) ones (b) one?
Can you help me? — Yes, I'd be happy (a) to help me (b) to.
Are you free tonight? If (a) so (b) it, let's go to the cinema.
Did they pass the test? — I'm afraid (a) no (b) not.
Are you going to finish the report today? — Yes, I think I will finish it today. (ответьте коротко, используя so)
Is the shop open on Sunday? — No, I don't think it is open on Sunday. (коротко)
Will they be late? — I hope they will not be late. (коротко)
I like the red jacket, but I don't like the green jacket. (замените второе jacket)
items.answer: I like the red jacket, but I don't like the green one. / I like the red one, but I don't like the green one.

items.prompt: She wanted to go to the concert, but she couldn't go to the concert. (сократите конец)
items.answer: She wanted to go to the concert, but she couldn't.

items.prompt: The manager told me to send the file, and I sent the file immediately. (используйте do so)
items.answer: The manager told me to send the file, and I did so immediately.

items.prompt: I've seen the film, but my brother hasn't seen the film. (сократите конец)
items.answer: I've seen the film, but my brother hasn't.

items.prompt: Are you ready? If you are ready, we can start. (замените: If you are ready, ...)
items.answer: Are you ready? If so, we can start.

items.prompt: I hope so not.
Do you like this phone? I prefer the another one.
items.answer: Do you like this phone? I prefer another one.

items.prompt: I think not so.
I need a laptop, and Tom needs a one too.
items.answer: I need a laptop, and Tom needs one too.

items.prompt: I think so that he will win.
items.answer: I think so. / I think that he will win. / I think he will win.

items.prompt: Which books do you want? The ones red.
items.answer: Which books do you want? The red ones.

items.prompt: I wasn't going to tell her, but I had tell her.
items.answer: I wasn't going to tell her, but I had to.

items.prompt: Is it true? — I'm afraid yes.
items.answer: Is it true? — I'm afraid so.

items.prompt: Будет ли встреча сегодня? — Думаю, да.
items.answer: Will there be a meeting today? — I think so. / Is there going to be a meeting today? — I think so.

items.prompt: Тебе нравится эта куртка? Мне больше нравится та, синяя.
items.answer: Do you like this jacket? I prefer the blue one. / Do you like this jacket? I like the blue one more.

items.prompt: Сайт упал снова? — Надеюсь, что нет.
items.answer: Has the site crashed again? — I hope not. / Has the website crashed again? — I hope not. / Did the site crash again? — I hope not.

items.prompt: Мне нужен новый монитор, а старый уже не работает.
items.answer: I need a new monitor, and the old one doesn't work anymore. / I need a new monitor because the old one doesn't work anymore.

items.prompt: Она сказала, что поможет, и она это сделала.
items.answer: She said she would help, and she did. / She said that she would help, and she did.

items.prompt: У тебя есть время? Если да, давай обсудим проект.
items.answer: Do you have time? If so, let's discuss the project.

items.prompt: Мы выиграем тендер? — Боюсь, что нет.
items.answer: Will we win the tender? — I'm afraid not. / Are we going to win the tender? — I'm afraid not.

items.prompt: Я не хотел идти на конференцию, но мне пришлось.
items.answer: I didn't want to go to the conference, but I had to.
